description: Pre-archimedean foundation of the alpha_{basis-knot} coupling family (owner: take up + finish; no pi). The 6 cohomological force-knots on Sigma_4 each carry the q-dimension decoration delta_q(T_{2,k}) = q^k-q^-k = h[k]_q in R=Z[q^+-1/2,h^-1] (no pi). alpha_EM := alpha_{T_2_3} (trefoil, electromagnetic) has the pre-archimedean bare form 1/alpha_EM = q[9]_q[10]_q = h^2/(q delta_q(T_{2,9}) delta_q(T_{3,5})) (the antisymmetric e_- / sinh Hopf coupling, prop:alpha-em-categorical-trace-ratio), bare residual -1.55e-3 vs CODATA. The pi-carrying corrections 2/(3pi)+alpha/(4pi) are the archimedean image of the Hopf S^1->S^3->S^2 / e_- sinh channel (the SAME channel as van der Waals, prop:vdw-pskew-isolation); the program's optimization is to express them by their pre-archimedean sinh/q source. The 3-strand T_{3,4} delta_q (Rosso-Jones) and the per-force alpha_K assembly are the open next steps. Nothing fitted.

data.finding: The alpha_{basis-knot} family is founded on the pre-archimedean q-dimension decorations delta_q(T_{2,k}) = q^k-q^-k = h[k]_q (no pi). alpha_EM := alpha_{T_2_3} bare = 1/(q[9]_q[10]_q) (the e_- sinh Hopf coupling), residual -1.55e-3. The pi corrections are the archimedean image of the Hopf/e_-/sinh channel (= the van der Waals channel); the no-pi optimization is their pre-archimedean sinh/q source. Open: 3-strand T_{3,4} Rosso-Jones exponent; the per-force alpha_K assembly (which carriers mediate which force).
